basics.name: Raul Medeiros
basics.label: Technology Consultant & Software Engineering PhD
basics.summary: PhD in Computer Science working as a Technology Consultant at LKS Next. Specialized in GenAI, Data Spaces, and Software Product Lines. Passionate about solving complex, real-world problems and exploring new technologies.

work.name: LKS Next
work.summary: Involved in the development of GenAI projects aimed at automating repetitive, non-value-added tasks for clients. Part of the design and implementation of dataspaces to ensure secure and efficient data sharing across platforms. Actively participating in several R&D European projects.

work.name: University of the Basque Country (UPV/EHU) - Onekin Research Group
work.summary: Development of PhD Thesis on Software Product Line Engineering (SPLE). Focused on SPL Onboarding, Visualization/Visual Analytics, and Continuous Deployment.

work.name: Indaba Consultores S.L.
work.summary: Migration of a legacy web platform into a microservice (REST) architecture. Frontend on Hippo CMS, backend on Spring Boot. Implemented SSO with Keycloak and used Jenkins for CI/CD.

work.name: AMPO S. Coop
work.summary: Development of a database monitoring system using microservices (Spring Boot, Netflix Zuul). IT Management of two mobile applications, coordinating with providers and gathering requirements.

work.name: Gaia Net Exchange
work.summary: Thin client development in C# for Gaia Net Exchange platform.

projects.name: CustomDIFF
projects.description: CustomDIFF is a web-based Visual Analytics tool for Software Product Lines Customization Analysis. CustomDIFF uses pure::variants and Git as the variability manager and code repository, respectively.

projects.name: FeatureCloud
projects.description: FeatureCloud is a tag based visualization tool used to improve comprehensibility and maintenance of preprocessor-based SPL code.
